entity: US home-purchase mortgage denial rate, Black vs white applicants, 2017
why: Urban Institute: Black denial rate 2.0x white in 2017, our number; CFPB/FFIEC says the same in words for 2017 purchase loans. 'At every big lender' has no count or names, so it isn't more; Urban's 1.2x is a credit-adjusted measure, and Reveal/Zillow predate 2017 data, so no contradiction.
